  <bpmn:process id="Process_ViennaNightRun" name="App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Participate" name="Want to participate">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectBlock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectStartingBlock" name="Select starting block">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectBlock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectBlock_Run5km</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Run5km" name="Run 5 km and measure time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectBlock_Run5km</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Train_Run5km</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Run5km_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under25Min" name="Time less than 25 minutes?" default="Flow_NotUnder25">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Run5km_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Under25</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotUnder25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Train" name="Train and check time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotUnder25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Train_Run5km</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GetStartingNumber" name="Get starting number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Under25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GetNumber_CheckWorkEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWorkdayEnd" name="Check time between starting time and end of workday">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GetNumber_CheckWorkEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckWorkEnd_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreThanOneHour" name="More than one hour left?" default="Flow_LeaveFromWork">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckWorkEnd_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MoreThanOneHour</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoFromHome" name="Go to Night Run from home">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MoreThanOneHour</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromHome_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromWork_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DepartureJoin" name="Departure determined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromHome_Join</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Run5km_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_Run5km" targetRef="Gateway_Under25Min"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under25" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Under25Min" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GetNumber_CheckWorkEnd" sourceRef="Task_GetStartingNumber" targetRef="Task_CheckWorkdayEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckWorkEnd_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckWorkdayEnd" targetRef="Gateway_MoreThanOneHour"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreThanOneHour" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreThanOneHour" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${moreThanOneHourLeft}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveFromWork" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreThanOneHour" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromHome_Join" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_DepartureJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromWork_Join" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_DepartureJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_RunAndDrink" sourceRef="Gateway_DepartureJoin" targetRef="Task_RunAndDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunAndDrink_ReceiveTime" sourceRef="Task_RunAndDrink" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveTime_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drink_RunDrinkJoin" sourceRef="Task_Drink" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunDrinkJoin_ReceiveTime" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveTime_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ViennaNightRun" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/viennanightrun">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ViennaNightRun" name="App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Participate" name="Want to participate">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectBlock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectStartingBlock" name="Select starting block">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectBlock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectBlock_AttemptMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RunAttemptMerge" name="Run attempt">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectBlock_AttemptMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Train_AttemptMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AttemptMerge_RunSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunSplit" name="Start run and time recording">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AttemptMerge_RunSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunSplit_Run</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunSplit_Record</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Run5km" name="Run 5 km">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunSplit_Run</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Run_RunJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordRunningTime" name="Record running time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunSplit_Record</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_RunJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunJoin" name="Run and time recording completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Run_RunJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Record_RunJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunJoin_Under25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under25Min" name="Time less than 25 minutes?" default="Flow_NotUnder25">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunJoin_Under25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Under25</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotUnder25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrainAndCheck" name="Train and check time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotUnder25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Train_AttemptMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GetStartingNumber" name="Get starting number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Under25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GetNumber_CheckWorkEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWorkdayEnd" name="Check time between starting time and end of workday">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GetNumber_CheckWorkEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckWorkEnd_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MoreThanOneHour" name="More than one hour left?" default="Flow_LeaveFromWork">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckWorkEnd_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MoreThanOneHour</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoFromHome" name="Go to Night Run from home">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MoreThanOneHour</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromHome_DepartureMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FromWork_DepartureMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DepartureMerge" name="Departure determined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromHome_DepartureMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromWork_DepartureMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DepartureMerge_RunDrinkSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunDrinkSplit" name="Start running and drinking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DepartureMerge_RunDrinkSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunDrinkSplit_Run</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunDrinkSplit_Drink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunNightRun" name="Run the Night Run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunDrinkSplit_Run</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunNightRun_RunDrinkJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Drink" name="Drink while running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunDrinkSplit_Drink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Drink_RunDrinkJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin" name="Running and drinking completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunNightRun_RunDrinkJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Drink_RunDrinkJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunDrinkJoin_ReceiveTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" name="Receive final running time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunDrinkJoin_ReceiveTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveTime_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived" name="Final running time received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveTime_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SelectBlock" sourceRef="StartEvent_Participate" targetRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectBlock_AttemptMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock" targetRef="Gateway_RunAttemptMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Train_AttemptMerge" sourceRef="Task_TrainAndCheck" targetRef="Gateway_RunAttemptMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AttemptMerge_RunSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_RunAttemptMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RunSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunSplit_Run" sourceRef="Gateway_RunSplit" targetRef="Task_Run5km"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunSplit_Record" sourceRef="Gateway_RunSplit" targetRef="Task_RecordRunningTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Run_RunJoin" sourceRef="Task_Run5km" targetRef="Gateway_RunJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_RunJoin" sourceRef="Task_RecordRunningTime" targetRef="Gateway_RunJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunJoin_Under25" sourceRef="Gateway_RunJoin" targetRef="Gateway_Under25Min"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under25" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Under25Min" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${timeLessThan25Minutes}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotUnder25" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Under25Min" targetRef="Task_TrainAndCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GetNumber_CheckWorkEnd" sourceRef="Task_GetStartingNumber" targetRef="Task_CheckWorkdayEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckWorkEnd_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckWorkdayEnd" targetRef="Gateway_MoreThanOneHour"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreThanOneHour" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreThanOneHour" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${moreThanOneHourLeft}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveFromWork" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MoreThanOneHour" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromHome_DepartureMerge" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_DepartureMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromWork_DepartureMerge" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_DepartureMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DepartureMerge_RunDrinkSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_DepartureMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrinkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunDrinkSplit_Run" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrinkSplit" targetRef="Task_RunNightRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunDrinkSplit_Drink" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrinkSplit" targetRef="Task_Drink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunNightRun_RunDrinkJoin" sourceRef="Task_RunNightRun" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drink_RunDrinkJoin" sourceRef="Task_Drink" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunDrinkJoin_ReceiveTime" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveTime_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
